title: Private lesson cancellation
content: Private lessons must be cancelled at least 24 hours before the scheduled start time. Late cancellations may not be eligible for a refund.

title: Court booking duration
content: Court bookings use 60-minute time slots. This describes the booking duration only. Exact start times and live court availability are not stored in the knowledge base. Customers should arrive at least 10 minutes before the booking.

title: Beginner drop-in
content: The beginner drop-in is suitable for new and recreational players. Registration is required and spaces are limited.

title: Coach Amy profile
content: Coach Amy focuses on beginner fundamentals, footwork and junior training. She teaches private, semi-private and beginner group lessons.

title: Coach David profile
content: Coach David focuses on intermediate and advanced singles strategy, movement and match preparation.

title: Coach Lily Chen profile
content: Coach Lily Chen focuses on fundamentals, footwork and junior development for beginner and intermediate players.

title: Coach Daniel Wong profile
content: Coach Daniel Wong focuses on singles strategy, movement and match preparation for intermediate and advanced players.

title: Private lesson options
content: Private coaching is available as one-to-one, one-to-two or one-to-three 60-minute lessons customized to the players' skill levels and goals.

title: Semi-private lesson
content: A semi-private lesson is a 60-minute private coaching session for two or three players of a similar skill level.

title: Basic group class
content: The basic group class focuses on beginner fundamentals, movement and consistency. It is designed for beginner and recreational players.

title: Advanced group class
content: The advanced group class focuses on faster movement, tactics and match preparation. It is designed for intermediate and advanced players.

title: Court facilities
content: The club provides badminton courts, change rooms, seating areas and equipment rental.

title: Racket rental
content: Rackets are available for rental at the front desk, subject to availability.

title: What to bring
content: Players should bring indoor court shoes, sports clothing, water and a badminton racket.
